text: With your teen, and a professional if possible, make a safety card: warning signs they recognise, ways to calm down, trusted people, professional and emergency numbers, and steps to remove dangerous means. Save it on both phones; in immediate danger, call emergency services.

review_defects.why: Arabic specifies 'your son' (ابنك) but English uses gender-neutral 'your teen'.
The phrase 'في بلدكم' (in your country) is omitted in the English.
The Arabic specifies 'in your country' which is dropped in English.
The Arabic is a cautionary statement that the card does not replace emergency services; the English turns it into an imperative instruction.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: re-addressed to the parent (the tip spoke to the teen); the Saudi-only 937 line replaced by country-neutral emergency guidance.
